title: Requesting a Non-Catalog Item with an Ad Hoc Vendor
body:
Requesting a Non-Catalog Item with an Ad Hoc Vendor

You can use ad hoc vendors for non-catalog requests in guided buying.

Prerequisites

Your site must be configured to use ad hoc suppliers.

Context

Ad hoc vendors are suppliers from your SAP Ariba Buying solution that can be be added as-needed without onboarding them in your system. When the Use Ad Hoc Supplier option is available on non-catalog requests, you can choose from the ad hoc vendors available. When you use an ad hoc vendor, you must enter contact details for the supplier. The contact details are used to complete the transaction.

Ad hoc vendors also use virtual card payments, which generate new virtual card numbers for each order and display less banking information. Virtual cards offer secure transactions with new suppliers typically used for one-time or infrequent purchases.

Consider the following when using ad hoc suppliers:

  • The imported ad hoc vendor details, including their supplier locations, cannot be modified.

  • Ad hoc vendors can be used to buy only goods using a non-catalog request form. They can't be used for services. If you create a non-catalog request and choose an ad hoc vendor, categories associated with services can't be selected.

  • Requests with ad hoc vendors can have multiple line items, but all the line items must use ad hoc vendors.

  • After your request is submitted, approvers can change the ad hoc supplier and the contact details before the request is approved.

  • Supplier selection policies configured in guided buying don't effect which ad hoc suppliers are available.

Procedure

  1. On your dashboard, choose Quick Links  Request a non-catalog item or the plus symbol ().
  2. Choose the Goods tab.
  3. In the Product name field, enter a name for the product you need.
  4. For the Category field, choose the category that most accurately describes what you're requesting.

    Choose Browse all from the dropdown menu to display all categories.

  5. In the Description field, enter a description for the product you need.
  6. To use an ad hoc supplier, choose the Use Ad Hoc Supplier check box, and then select the supplier you want to use.
  7. To add contact information for the ad hoc supplier, choose Add Contact and enter the following contact information:
    Tip

    You can search for existing supplier contact information by entering the supplier's email address. If the supplier's contact information was used for a previous request, the information will display.

    • Email ID

      Caution

      The Email ID can't contain the plus symbol (+).

    • Name

    • Address 1

    • City

    • State/Province

    • Zip code

    • Country/Region

    Click Add.

    Remember

    Entering the correct contact information ensures timely payment and reduces the risk of payment failure or delays. This information also provides a record of the transaction, which supports audit and compliance requirements.

  8. Choose Add to cart.
  9. After you add the first item to the shopping cart, you can choose:
    OptionDescription

    Done

    Returns to the home page

    More options menu () > Create new

    Clears the page and allows you to create another non-catalog line and add it to the shopping cart

    More options menu () > Copy

    Leaves the existing information on the page and allows you to edit it to create another non-catalog line
  10. To check out, choose Check out.
  11. To see additional fields, choose the right arrow to expand a line item. Edit fields that have incorrect information.
  12. Choose Submit.
  13. A confirmation dialog box displays. Choose Done to go to the home page.
